gift_policy.policy_text: Employees may not accept gifts valued over $50 from vendors, clients, or external parties without prior written approval from the Ethics & Compliance office. Cash and cash equivalents (gift cards, vouchers) are prohibited regardless of value. All accepted gifts must be reported within 5 business days using the gift disclosure form.
restriction_notes: Cash and cash-equivalent gifts are strictly prohibited.
Gifts from regulated vendors require written pre-approval.
Disclosure form must be submitted within 5 business days.

contracts.title: Retail Storefront Rental Agreement - Unit 5B
contracts.contract_text: This Rental Agreement ('Agreement') is entered into as of July 1, 2026 between Harbor Point Properties LLC ('Landlord') and Northline Goods Inc. ('Tenant'). Premises: Unit 5B, 214 Market Street, Portland, OR 97205. Term: 24 months commencing July 1, 2026 and ending June 30, 2028. Monthly Rent: $4,850 USD due on the 1st of each month. Security Deposit: $9,700 USD due upon signing. Use of Premises: Retail sale of household goods only. Maintenance: Tenant is responsible for routine interior maintenance; Landlord is responsible for structural repairs. Insurance: Tenant must maintain commercial general liability coverage throughout the term. Termination: Either party may terminate for material breach if the breach remains uncured for 30 days after written notice. Early Termination: Tenant may terminate with 90 days' written notice if the premises become unusable due to casualty and are not restored within 60 days. Governing Law: State of Oregon.
